description: Empowering databases with machine learning capabilities. Easily integrate AutoML and MLOps into SQL workflows to make predictions and automate models directly from within database.
feature1_des: Perform ML tasks directly from SQL queries, without the need for external tools or programming languages.
feature2_des: Automate the process of model selection, training, and deployment with built-in AutoML and MLOps tools.
feature3_des: Train and deploy machine learning models directly inside database for seamless integration with existing data workflows.
footer: WKE (Web Knowledge Extraction) focuses on developing Web information systems (WIS) for various domain requirements. By integrating systems and modules about web/text mining methods developed in WKE, WIS can be enhanced to advanced intelligent information systems.
